stories.headline: Oil Prices Plunge 7% as U.S. and Iran Signal Room for Diplomacy
stories.why: Flagged by keyword match on the headline/summary — check the source for full context.
stories.summary: Oil prices plunged nearly 7% on Monday after Washington and Tehran both signaled they would give diplomacy a chance, wiping out part of the war premium that lifted crude through October. Brent traded at $105.60 per barre
